provenance: Supervisor's opening redesign, 2026-10-09; not yet implemented in ROM
current_build: Prototype 003 is known good and remains unchanged

capture_scene.placed_at: left Poké Ball on lab table

lab_table.approach: freestanding table on right side of Oak's lab, in the spirit of Yellow
lab_table.interaction: approach a physical Poké Ball, inspect starter, confirm or decline

gender_selection_policy: Starter gender is independent of chosen player gender. Force via per-Pokémon personality/gender at creation, never by globally modifying species base data.

rival_visuals.kanto: Blue for overworld and battle assets; player-named rival

johto_preservation.starter_selection: keep original HeartGold presentation for later Johto event
johto_preservation.future_exception: eight Johto gym leaders scale by badge order as previously agreed

release_policy: When a complete, emulator-tested build is available, supply the owner's personally uploaded HeartGold-derived NDS via private conversation download, not as a public GitHub asset. Do not distribute an untested or broken build.

perfect_six_iv_bonus.rule: On bonus success all six are 31. Otherwise each IV is independent and uniformly random 0..31; accidental natural 6IV also remains possible.

generation_iv.shiny_rule: OT_ID low16 xor OT_ID high16 xor PID low16 xor PID high16 < 8
generation_iv.gender_rule: species personal-data gender threshold vs PID low byte

starter_creation.non_starter_scope: Leave ordinary wild and NPC Pokémon creation unchanged
starter_creation.integration_status: Pure creation-planning utilities and tests only. No live ROM branch yet.

ability_slots.chance_policy: Uniform 1-in-3 for each of three ability slots (per starter gift only). Hidden Ability must be flagged for evolution to preserve or map to the correct evolved third ability.
ability_slots.gen4_engine_status: All nine ability IDs exist natively; third species slot and Hidden Ability inheritance do not exist in stock HeartGold.
ability_slots.method: A Kanto-starter-only gift routine selects from the three ability IDs and explicitly sets MON_DATA_ABILITY. Preserve the selected third-slot marker across save/reload and map to compatible evolutionary Hidden Abilities; stock UpdateMonAbility will otherwise reset to the native two-slot ability.
ability_slots.evolution_note: Reconcile ability mapping for Eevee's seven Gen-IV evolutions, Psyduck to Golduck, and Togepi to Togetic/Togekiss. Some later-generation evolved Hidden Abilities such as Espeon's Magic Bounce are not available in unmodified Gen-IV; requires separately scoped fallback or added engine support.
ability_slots.cross_game_scope: Do not change Johto starter selection, wild Pokémon, general ability slots, or Silver.
